# countries-110m.json

World country geometry (TopoJSON, 1:110m) vendored from the npm package
[world-atlas](https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas) version 2, file
`countries-110m.json`.

The package redistributes [Natural Earth](https://www.naturalearthdata.com/)
data, which is in the public domain; the world-atlas build scripts are
ISC-licensed. Vendored locally so the published site contacts no external
host at runtime.
